{{recipesummary|category=Fruit recipes|servings=6|time=1 hour|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

'''Hot pineapple side dish''' is a casserole of pineapple with cheese.

==Ingredients==

* 1 can (20 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] / 600 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple chunks]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 1½ cups shredded [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]], divided
* ⅔ cup coarsely crushed [[Cookbook:Saltine Cracker|saltines]] (14 crackers)

==Procedure==
# Preheat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]] (175˚C).
# Grease a 1½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] (1½ liter) [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]].
# Drain the pineapple, reserving ¼ cup juice; set aside.
# In a small bowl, combine sugar and flour.
# Add the butter and 1 cup cheese; mix well.
# Gently stir in pineapple.
# Pour into the prepared baking dish.
# Sprinkle crushed crackers on top; drizzle with reserved pineapple juice.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]], uncovered, for 30–35 minutes or until bubbly around the edges.
# Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
